home.meta_description: Join free language conversation meetups. Practice English, Spanish, and more online or in-person with a global and welcoming community.
home.welcome_text: Practice English, Spanish and other languages for free and naturally. Join a vibrant community with online and in-person meetups across the country.

modalities.heading: Choose how to practice
modalities.desc: Whether online from anywhere in the world or in person in your city, we have the ideal format for you to start practicing today.
modalities.online_text: Weekly video conference meetups with people from all over the world. Filter by language and day, dedicated hosts and defined schedule.
modalities.presencial_text: Face-to-face meetups in cafes, parks and malls. Local groups organized by volunteers, expanding across and beyond the borders.

how_it_works.heading: Simple, free and hassle-free
how_it_works.step1_text: Browse the online schedule or find a local in-person group in your city.
how_it_works.step2_text: Enter the video call or go to the agreed location. Introduce yourself and start practicing.
how_it_works.step3_text: Come back whenever you want. Make friends, improve your fluency and be part of the community.

faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.a1: Yes, all our meetups, both online and in person, are 100% free and open to the community. Our goal is to democratize language practice.
faq.q2: Do I need to be advanced to participate?
faq.a2: No! We have participants of all levels. The environment is welcoming and focused on mutual learning. If you can introduce yourself, you can start practicing.
faq.q3: How do the in-person meetups work?
faq.a3: In-person meetups take place in public places such as cafes and malls. They are organized by local volunteers and don't have fixed dates, occurring according to group mobilization on WhatsApp.

how_it_works.label: How it works
how_it_works.heading: Simple, flexible and free
how_it_works.desc: Meetups don't have a fixed date. They happen as the local community mobilizes. You don't have to wait passively — make the meetup happen!
how_it_works.step1_text: Find the WhatsApp group for your city or region and join those who already want to practice languages in person.
how_it_works.step2_text: Invite friends while other members do the same. When demand grows, the organizer announces the date and place. The more people invite, the faster the meetup happens!
how_it_works.step3_title: Show up and live unforgettable moments
how_it_works.step3_text: Go to the meetup, introduce yourself and practice. You will leave with real friendships, amazing conversations and stories you didn't expect to have.

expand.heading: No meetup nearby?
expand.desc: We can create a space for your city! Get in touch and we'll set up a group within our community. You won't be alone and we'll support you every step of the way.
expand.step1_text: Once you reach out, we create a group for your city inside our community. You don't need to build anything from scratch! We handle it together with you.
expand.step2_text: No fixed commitment. While the community grows, you can take the opportunity to share the news with your friends and watch the group fill up naturally.
expand.step3_text: The mall food court is perfect: free space, no mandatory consumption. Cafes, parks or libraries also work!

organizer_cta.heading: We help you become an organizer
organizer_cta.desc: Organizing a meetup goes far beyond bringing people together to practice languages. No need to know everything beforehand. Our team supports you every step of the way. Get to know the full benefits for those who are part of our volunteer team.
